$comment: The audit findings the nightly CFC property suite is known to produce, and
the issue each is tracked under. The job fails on any finding not listed
here, AND on any entry here that stopped occurring — a fixed gap must take
its entry with it, so the list cannot rot into a permanent excuse. The list
shrinking is the progress signal; it is never appended to without an issue.
This is not a way to lower the bar. `--fail-on warn` stays where it is; an
entry names one check on one run shape, so a check that starts failing on a
shape nobody enumerated is still a red run.

Each entry names the runs it speaks for as an anchored regular expression over the run id. `runShape` is prose for a reader; `runs` is what matching uses, so an entry written for one shape cannot suppress the same message on a run nobody considered.

expected.runShape: a sandbox-only episode: an enforcing run whose tools reach the sandbox and which mints no handle
expected.detail: retained none of: a recorded cell-labels read
expected.why: the engine reads a space's cell labels only for the refs its handle table holds, so a run that minted no handle records no read at all. Whether AH-CFC-16 wants a recorded read from a run that touched no cell, or whether 'nobody asked' is the honest answer there, is the open question.

expected.runShape: a fabric-only episode: an enforcing run whose only side effect is `run_pattern`
expected.why: a `run_pattern` side effect reaches the fabric, not the sandbox that carries CFC evidence, so the run's enforcing claim goes untested. Honest reduced assurance rather than a defect. AUD-9 reads the same fact for retention and warns beside this one; both close together when a property drives a labeled flow through a sandbox side effect as well.

expected.runShape: the property corpus, whose runs attest no CFC substrate
expected.why: the suite's episodes supply no run manifest, so every run records `not-attested` and the refusal count carries that qualifier. It closes when the suite runs under a manifest.

expected.runShape: a fabric-only episode: an enforcing run whose only side effect reaches the fabric
expected.why: the same fact AUD-2 warns about, read for retention. A run that recorded no invocation context could have run host-side or could have lost the evidence, and a tool activity states neither, so the check says unconfirmed rather than missing. It closes with the AUD-2 warning beside it.
